explanations.title: Arbitrary file write or delete
explanations.why_it_matters: Unrestricted writes or deletes can corrupt data, remove user files, or change application behavior.
explanations.remediation: Limit operations to an allowlisted workspace, require narrowly scoped paths, and apply safeguards for destructive changes.

explanations.title: Path traversal
explanations.why_it_matters: Traversal sequences can escape an intended directory boundary and reach unrelated files.
explanations.remediation: Canonicalize paths, verify the resolved path remains under an allowlisted root, and reject traversal forms.
